Point_Coordinates.focus: Carry the existing black sphere and compare LOCAL with WORLD. Read what makes the body grabbable and how its position is expressed in each coordinate frame. The XR player setup is supplied; the pickable-body connection is part of this lesson. Distance calculation belongs in Point Lines.

Primitives_Godot.focus: Return to PointBody to study resolution as a construction parameter. Compare rings-only and segments-only changes on independent spheres while radius, appearance and spherical collision stay fixed. Pickup and the fully printed held-time controller support the comparison: holding reduces resolution, release pauses, and reset restores. Stop at valid lower bounds. Carry controllable construction into Columns and later abilities.

subjects: Reusing a drawing as a sculpture
Changing a copy while keeping the original
Point_Line_Grid.focus: Meet the drawing saved in Trace as a sculpture in Grid. One sampled record supports several representations: an ordered array, visible segments and rounded XYZ addresses. Keep the pink source intact while changing an independent green copy. Predict an address, compare pitches and flatten only the copy. Carry the preserved source into Triangle.

subjects: Saving the drawing for the next hall
Point_Trace.focus: Inside the Trace hall, retain local positions in metres with an array, minimum-distance condition and neighbour loop. Connect the existing release event to the supplied archive. Save the visible segments as a static sculpture with their position record; carry it to Grid in the same project.

subjects: A closed boundary and a face
A guard for a collapsed triangle
Point_Triangle_Context.focus: Bring the original saved Trace positions through Grid. Lines already connected positions; now choose three entries and store their ordered connection as a face recipe. Reuse PointBody handles, move a corner, reverse the front and collapse the face to test its guard. Preserve the archive. Carry positions and connectivity into the first enclosure.

Primitives_Polythedra.focus: Reload the same three selected Trace positions and add an apex behind their plane. Store four positions once and address them with four face-index triples. Move the shared apex and see three faces change together; distinguish a closed visible surface from a collider. Carry the position/connectivity separation and FaceBody into Cube.

Point_Animatedcube.focus: Build CubeBody from eight shared corners and twelve triangles using the previous face renderer. Compare two independent instances with different front-face diagonals. Deform a corner, then move the whole node, distinguishing a construction edit from a placement. Keep the reusable cube for later composition, Transformation and Arrays.

Primitives_Ignorance.focus: Return to the authored position lists from Cube. Generate an octahedron list with a named function and a radius: positive and negative multiples of three axes. Render the supplied face recipe, call the function again and modify one independent result. Explain which choice belongs to the generating rule and which to a returned position. Carry parameters, return values and rule/output separation.

subjects: A profile as a radius list
Nested loops over rings and sides
Comparing one variable at a time
Primitives_Columns.focus: Use a radius profile and two loops to generate stacked ring positions. Compare the same profile and height at 4, 6, 8, 12 and 16 sides with a supplied circle sampler and surface stitcher. Then change silhouette and height separately. Carry independent construction parameters and the profile/placement distinction into borrowed letter outlines.

subjects: A supplied outline with a hole
Primitives_Profiles.focus: Return to Columns: a ring section carried through heights made a body. Borrow an O outline, including its hole, and carry that section through five parallel placements. Change sideways travel first; then compare width, depth and a C section. Preserve the supplied outline. Font extraction, triangulation and general curved-path frames stay supplied or deferred. Carry section and route as separate choices; visible hollow geometry does not supply collision.

subjects: A while loop with a stopping rule
Primitives_Portals.focus: Reuse the supplied circle sampler and LineSkin to measure a closed polygon. Sum neighbour lengths, including last to first, and compare with the finite TAU-based circumference reference. Increase sides until the metre tolerance is met or the sample budget is spent. Trigonometric derivation stays supplied. Test a tighter tolerance and an unattainable request; carry a stopping rule that names both error and cost.

Primitives_Melencolia.focus: Compose with learned CubeBody instances and the familiar PointBody. Change placements without changing construction data; reconstruct a second arrangement from script values. Scale and rotation wait for Transformation. Then attempt an independent arrangement: generate positions, retain a source and alter a copy, reuse a valid face and compare two sphere resolutions. Explain the construction choices and the arrangement; automated checks alone cannot establish that understanding.

subjects: Animation: a transform changing over time
Trans_Pre.focus: Return to CubeBody from Cube and Melencolia. Set its position, Y orientation and uniform scale separately, restoring the initial values between comparisons. Keep the same corner and face data; identify what each transform preserves. Locate the bottom-centre origin so scaling has an explicit anchor. Then let elapsed seconds carry the cube upward in one finite linear journey. Change the duration without changing the destination; combine a fixed turn and size with that translation. Choose another angle and predict which corner moves and which distance stays fixed. The museum supplies the surrounding room and installed pickups. Carry three distinct operations on one construction.
